question: Are rainfall-associated route-new species incidences mainly recurrent activation of taxa/sites observed in other monitoring years, rather than one-off first records within the route-season stratum?
population: Frozen NAAMP matched pairs restricted to pairs with identical nonmissing SiteID at all ten StopNumbers.
focal_units: Wet incidences belonging to species absent from the entire dry route but present in the wet route.

leave_pair_out_memory.same_site_recurrent: Species was detected at the same physical SiteID in any other eligible run of the same State x RouteNumber x RunNumber stratum, excluding the wet and dry runs of the focal pair.
leave_pair_out_memory.route_only_recurrent: Species was detected in another eligible run of the same stratum, but never at the focal SiteID outside the pair.
leave_pair_out_memory.one_off_stratum_record: Species had no detection in any other eligible run of the same stratum outside the focal pair.

primary_models: Fit each pair-level component and their recurrent sum with the existing matched-pair model: rain_contrast + temperature_difference + day_of_year_difference + year_gap + State + RunNumber; route-clustered covariance.
primary_rule: Recurrent activation is supported if the recurrent-sum rain coefficient has complete 95% CI >0 and contributes >50% of the total route-new wet-incidence rain coefficient.

temporal_sensitivity.definition: Repeat classification using only eligible runs strictly earlier than the earlier survey year in the matched pair.
temporal_sensitivity.gate: >=1500 pairs and >=300 routes with at least one prior eligible run in the same stratum.
temporal_sensitivity.interpretation: Prior-only support strengthens the reading of reactivation of a previously observed local acoustic pool; failure does not invalidate leave-pair-out recurrence because early programme years have little prior history.

interpretation: Recurrent detection across years supports behavioural/acoustic reactivation more than literal colonization, but does not prove continuous occupancy between surveys.
Route-only recurrence does not identify movement during the focal rain event.
One-off records can reflect true rarity, detection limits, or transient occurrence.
No causal rainfall or reproductive-success claim is authorized.
